create_dqn_agents: create DQN agents for the Breakthrough game with configurable hidden layers and replay buffer
run_training_loop: run a DQN training loop on the Breakthrough game with configurable episodes and evaluation frequency
eval_against_random_bots: evaluate trained DQN agents against random bots and return mean episode rewards
build_rl_environment: build an OpenSpiel RL environment for the Breakthrough game with custom board dimensions
save_load_checkpoints: save and load DQN agent neural network weights to a checkpoint directory
